rationale: Excluded (E01 - wrong topic; also fails E05 - no empirical evidence). This 1961 law review article examines general French administrative and corporate law governing public and semi-public corporations (such as Rolland's doctrinal principles of public service and immunity of nationalized enterprises from execution), with no focus on household or community water or sanitation service access and no empirical data or systematic review synthesis.
plain_vs_narrow_note: Both the narrow and plain Criterion 2 readings yield an exclude decision because the record is a 1961 doctrinal comparative public-law article on general public and semi-public corporations in France rather than an empirical study of household or community water or sanitation service access (failing Criteria 1, 3 and 4).
